parent_objective: localize M1738 outcome dominance without new rollout before task-quality redesign or ranking
blocked_by: M1738 outcome distribution is dominated by off-track and collision modes
supersedes: direct controller-family ranking from M1738 public diagnostic rows

public_gates: M1740 must use existing M1738 episode rows only
M1740 must not run environment rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles or rank controller families
M1740 must localize outcome dominance by scenario family label profile and key buckets
M1740 must distinguish execution pass from task-quality readiness
M1740 must decide redesign localization branch synthesis or bounded evaluation-panel design
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat unsupported faults as covered

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes no-rollout localization of M1738 off-track/collision dominance before redesign or comparison
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-rollout diagnostic localization only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if any new environment rollout is needed
stop if localization ranks profiles instead of diagnosing workload/outcome structure
stop if unsupported faults are treated as covered
stop if localization cannot identify dominant scenario/profile/bucket slices
fallback_plan: route to task-quality redesign if dominance is diffuse
route to bounded evaluation-panel design if dominance localizes to repairable slices
route to branch synthesis if the branch needs a broader decision before more milestones
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1739 audits M1738 as execution-positive but outcome-dominated

admission_evidence: M1739 found M1738 execution pass but raw outcomes are dominated by off-track and collision
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
allowed_updates: M1740 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up route manifest if localization admits it
next_stage_criteria: claim boundary remains execution/task-quality diagnostic only

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; outcome localization cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: localization may preserve profile controls but must not interpret them as self-ID evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1738 repaired scenario taxonomy execution rows.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If dominance is diffuse, record that as task-quality redesign evidence rather than self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1738 non-success dominance can be localized from existing episode rows before any redesign or controller-family comparison.
success_criteria: localization uses existing M1738 episode rows only
family outcome label profile bucket and repair-variant localization artifacts exist
dominant non-success slices are identified without ranking controller families
next route is task-quality redesign bounded evaluation-panel design branch synthesis or stop
environment rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes ranking and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: localization ranks controller-family profiles from public rows
training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
paper-level or level3 claims are made
decision_rule: M1740 passes if it localizes M1738 outcome dominance from existing rows and chooses a route without new rollout or profile ranking.
